protocol_description: NASA PCoE aging: charge CC 1.5A to 4.2V then CV to 20 mA; discharge multi_load_1_2_4A to 2.5V cutoff at ambient 24 degC; EIS 0.1Hz-5kHz sweep between charge/discharge. Mixed 24/44 degC; multi-level discharge 1/2/4 A.
source_citation: Saha, B. & Goebel, K. (2007). Battery Data Set. NASA Prognostics Data Repository, NASA Ames Research Center, Moffett Field, CA. https://www.nasa.gov/intelligent-systems-division/discovery-and-systems-health/pcoe/pcoe-data-set-repository/ Cells are 18650 Li-ion; chemistry/vendor not disclosed by NASA - community consensus treats them as LCO.
